Episode 217. The Reason for Ayulra's Manifestation (3)
Zito blinked for a moment, alternating his gaze between Ayulra and the dimensional gate.

[Phew... Ha-ha-ha-ha! What if you close that? Do you think I'll be surprised and cower in fear? Ayulra, you foolish friend. How can you be fooled by such a simple act! Have you been half-hearted so far because you were really spending energy to block that?]
From the beginning, Zito had been eyeing that.
He was confident that Ayulra had decided on his annihilation today.

[First, block the way back, then somehow strike me hard and try to deal with me using the humans under this boundary. If I hadn't regained my strength so much, it would have been a good strategy. Unfortunately... that's not the case.]
As soon as the door was confirmed closed, Zito's appearance began to change. New spines sprouted from his wings and body, and his wavering face became clearer.
[Once I kill you and find the eye, such tricks are useless. Let's start again, foolish Peace.]
Every time Zito swung his twin spiked axes, the sky distorted.
The same happened to Ayulra's physical body where the axe hit. Blood, bone, and flesh crumpled, and a sound more terrible than a scream was made.
The praying believers shed tears thinking about the pain Ayulra was experiencing, and Jin and Murakan narrowed their eyes.
If the battle continues like this, the result will inevitably end in Ayulra's defeat.

"Gosh, isn't Ayulra really going to lose like this? Even though he can't use all his power because he's a human, isn't he pushed too much? Ah, the barrier. He's already lacking power, is it because he poured too much into the barrier?"
"...That's right, Murakan. Ayulra is going to lose today."
At Jin's words, Murakan's eyes widened.
"What?"
"The outcome of this battle was decided from the start. Ayulra never once said he would break Zito. He never said he would annihilate him. He only said he would inflict irreparable damage."
Ayulra's goal was not victory from the start.
He knew better than anyone that it was impossible. As Murakan said, the human world is not a place where Ayulra can exert his full power.
"In my view, Zito has fallen into a trap. I don't know Ayulra's exact intentions, but after the battle ends, Ayulra's authority applied to the dimensional gate will certainly trip up Zito."
"I hope your words are true."
It wasn't that Jin wasn't worried at all.

-[Originally, even if I were to lose some of my authority this time, I intended to inflict irreversible damage on him. I judged that he could be more threatening in the mortal realm if he fully recovered his power.]
The words that Ayura had just spoken in the gray area.
Even if the fight went perfectly according to Ayura's intention, he was bound to lose some of his authority today.
'Perhaps...... This is probably the first and last time that Ayura himself intervenes in the mortal realm and fights directly. All we can do is hope that the fight ends according to Ayura's will.'
If things go wrong, there is also a possibility that Ayura could disappear.
On the other hand, there was no chance of that happening to Jito. Ayura himself had made it clear that it was impossible.

[I can almost see the crying faces of your children under the barrier. My eyes must have been eager to see that sight as well. For such a long time, my eyes have been locked away without seeing anything beautiful.]
Clang-!
The thorny axe struck Ayura's head.
Ayura couldn't recover as quickly as Jito. He controlled the spears with part of his head torn off, and it seemed at a glance that there was a problem with his vision.
Two more wings were torn. The number of times the spear penetrated Jito's body was gradually decreasing, while the number of times the thorny axe tormented Ayura was increasing.
It wasn't a fight between two beings of similar strength anymore, but a situation where one-sided violence had begun on one side.
Thump......!
Eventually, Jito plunged the thorny axe into Ayura's chest and threw him up to the barrier. The shock transmitted to the inside of the barrier caused a brief earthquake throughout the kingdom.
The earthquake quickly intensified.

It was because Jito, who was on top of Ayura, was incessantly striking him down with the hilt of his axe. The barrier formed by Ayura's true energy was still strong, but it seemed like it could crack at any moment.

[Ha ha ha, do you feel like a pathetic beast? Starving and finally finding prey. A mother tired of protecting her eggs. The mother will try to protect the eggs from the predator at all costs, but she can't. Why? Because the beast is Jito!]
Jito raised his voice, mad with delight, comparing the crack to eggs.
[Ayura! It's such a pleasure for me to have met you first in the mortal realm. I've been looking forward to this moment for a very long time.]
[You talk a lot. You seem to have the upper hand, but you still seem uneasy, Jito.]
[Yes, I am uneasy! I am scared and anxious. That's why I'm babbling like this, just like animals often howl.]
[It seems like you have a good sense of situation for an immortal. Well, now slowly give me your gift. I will show you what the reality of your unknown fear was.]
Suddenly, Ayura spread his wings wide. Until then, Ayura had been using his wings as a shield to block the ax blows from Jito, who had climbed on top of him.
And then, Ayura embraced Jito with his roughly ten remaining wings.
Jito tried to tear off the wings, but the wings that had been so easily torn and fallen off until now did not budge.
The thorns piercing through the wings from Jito were holding their state in place. The two immortals looked like a large cocoon tied into one.
For the first time, Ayura smirked.
[You just said it's been a while since one of your eyes saw something beautiful…….]
[What are you trying to do?]
[To me, it seems the same for your remaining eye. A world filled with pain, how can such a thing be beautiful? So let me show you. Something truly beautiful.]
Roaaar-!
A brighter golden light flashed from within the wings soaked in golden blood.
And Jito felt the sensation of Ayura's energy spreading in his wings, invading his brain. That energy forcefully formed several images and sounds in Jito's head.
Of course, they were made up of the sights and sounds Jito despised the most.
Let's be together, in a peaceful and beautiful world......!
The first thing that resonated in Jito's head was a verse from a hymn praising Ayura.
There was also the sight of millions of believers all singing in unison, all wearing bright expressions.
[You're crazy, aargh!]
For the first time, Jito shivered and showed a painful expression.
He was an immortal who was mad with pain to the point of torturing himself, but he didn't have much resistance to this type of 'awkward pain'.
[This is nothing, this is a pain I haven't yet conquered.]
Just seeing that scene was a great psychological shock to Jito.
Because it was an illusion created within, he couldn't kill or torture the singing believers, and he couldn't easily detach Ayura.
[I've got chills!]
[There's a lot left. Next, you'll see the sight of those weary of life being saved by someone's help. And they end up living a happy life…….]
[You call yourself a god of peace and do such horrible things, you demon...! Go to hell!]
The praying people were so focused that they couldn't hear their conversation at all, but Jin and Murakan were momentarily speechless.
"......Is this what I'm thinking? Could we really torment that guy, Jito, in this way?"
"It's shocking in many ways, me too."
The figure of Jito, who had been overwhelming Ayura all along, was nowhere to be seen. There was only a pitiful demon who hated light and healing to the extreme.
[Stop it, enough!]
However, infiltrating Jito's inner self was something that required a great deal of resolution for Ayura himself.
Just as Ayura was defiling Jito's inner self, Jito was also eroding Ayura's inner self.

Ayura was facing a more vivid illusion than reality of the world burning and suffering in front of his eyes. Even though he knew it was an illusion, he couldn't deny it with his divine insight, just as he couldn't counteract Ayura's spirit that had infiltrated his inner self.
Whose inner self will crumble faster?
In the end, that was the last of the fight. Therefore, Ayura was certain of his defeat.
At such times, whoever has more something they love, something they need to protect, is bound to lose. Ayura was vomiting blood, flipping his eyes, but Jito's screams were gradually subsiding.
And finally, Ayura's wings broke. All wings fixed with thorns collapsed, revealing Ayura's wounded flesh.
Ayura looked as weak as a dying man. As soon as the wings holding him disappeared, Jito took distance and gasped for breath.
[Huff, huff... I almost got hooked on a strange taste. But this is also a kind of pain I have to conquer in the end. It was a great learning experience, Ayura.]
Ayura couldn't answer and gasped for breath.
If now, Jito could definitely finish Ayura. Because Ayura could no longer counterattack.
However, Jito had to choose.

Whether to use his remaining strength to finish Ayura now, or to rip through the barrier Ayura initially cast on the dimensional gate and return with that power. Although Ayura was near death, the barrier of the dimensional gate was still intact.
Jito chose the latter.
Because if he used all his strength to extinguish Ayura now, he wouldn't be able to deal with the humans under the barrier.

[Heh heh... Yes, I lost today. I was fooled. So this was why you were obsessed with the barrier. But I don't dislike this sense of defeat. It's an indescribably sticky and thrilling taste of defeat. Go back, next time we meet you will be weaker, Ayura. Then I will fully use you, and enjoy.]
Soon, Jito ripped off Ayura's power that was eating away at the dimensional gate.
And when Jito disappeared, Ayura fell below the barrier.
